$why: ONE template replacing THREE near-identical copies in run-agent-orchestration.sh
All three asked the same question in the same shape and differed only in the evidence
section. Three copies meant a wording fix was a three-place edit, and the copies had
already begun to drift: two showed a diff and one showed BEFORE/AFTER separately.
It is NOT merged with prd-change-reviewer, which looks similar and is not the same prompt:
that one carries a read-only-tools paragraph and a different output example
("issues":["<issue1>"] with a reason, versus empty here). Merging them would have silently
changed what two different agents are told.
The evidence SECTION is one value, heading included, because each caller has different
evidence to show — a diff, or a before and an after. A template that branches is a program.
description: Validate a proposed change against its evidence and return pass or fail.
